avg_dragon_prox.label: Distance to dragon before the objective
avg_dragon_prox.description: Average map distance from the dragon shortly before a dragon objective is taken.

csd10.label: CS difference at 10 minutes
csd10.description: Your creep-score lead or deficit versus the opposing laner at 10 minutes.

csd14.label: CS difference at 14 minutes
csd14.description: Your creep-score lead or deficit versus the opposing laner at 14 minutes.

csm10.label: CS per minute at 10 minutes
csm10.description: Your farming pace during the first 10 minutes, including lane minions and jungle monsters.

csm14.label: CS per minute at 14 minutes
csm14.description: Your farming pace during the first 14 minutes, including lane minions and jungle monsters.

deaths_early_2v2.label: Early 2v2 deaths
deaths_early_2v2.description: Deaths before 14 minutes in bot-lane 2v2 fights.

deaths_early_jungle.label: Early deaths involving the enemy jungler
deaths_early_jungle.description: Deaths before 14 minutes where the enemy jungler participated in the kill.

deaths_solo.label: Solo deaths
deaths_solo.description: Deaths classified as isolated one-versus-one situations.

deaths_teamfight.label: Non-solo deaths
deaths_teamfight.description: Deaths that were not classified as isolated one-versus-one situations.

frac_ahead.label: Time spent ahead in lane
frac_ahead.description: Share of observed lane snapshots where you had a gold lead over your lane opponent.

frac_behind.label: Time spent behind in lane
frac_behind.description: Share of observed lane snapshots where you had a gold deficit against your lane opponent.

frames_in_base_early.label: Early-game base presence
frames_in_base_early.description: Number of timeline snapshots spent inside your base before 14 minutes.

gd10.label: Gold difference at 10 minutes
gd10.description: Your gold lead or deficit versus the opposing laner at 10 minutes.

gd14.label: Gold difference at 14 minutes
gd14.description: Your gold lead or deficit versus the opposing laner at 14 minutes.

gpm10.label: Gold per minute at 10 minutes
gpm10.description: Your average gold income per minute during the first 10 minutes.

gpm14.label: Gold per minute at 14 minutes
gpm14.description: Your average gold income per minute during the first 14 minutes.

jungle_csd10.label: Jungle CS difference at 10 minutes
jungle_csd10.description: Your jungle-monster CS lead or deficit versus the enemy jungler at 10 minutes.

jungle_csd14.label: Jungle CS difference at 14 minutes
jungle_csd14.description: Your jungle-monster CS lead or deficit versus the enemy jungler at 14 minutes.

jungle_csm10.label: Jungle CS per minute at 10 minutes
jungle_csm10.description: Your jungle-monster farming pace during the first 10 minutes.

jungle_csm14.label: Jungle CS per minute at 14 minutes
jungle_csm14.description: Your jungle-monster farming pace during the first 14 minutes.

jungle_kill_participation_early.label: Early jungle kill participation
jungle_kill_participation_early.description: Share of allied champion kills before 14 minutes in which the jungler participated.

jungle_takedowns_early.label: Early jungle takedowns
jungle_takedowns_early.description: Kills and assists earned by the jungler before 14 minutes.

jungle_team_epic_monster_diff_early.label: Early epic-monster difference
jungle_team_epic_monster_diff_early.description: Allied epic monsters secured minus enemy epic monsters secured before 14 minutes.

jungle_team_epic_monsters_early.label: Early team epic monsters
jungle_team_epic_monsters_early.description: Epic monsters secured by your team before 14 minutes; this is a team outcome, not an individual attribution.

kda_1v1.label: Solo kill/death ratio
kda_1v1.description: Solo kills divided by solo deaths, with a minimum denominator of one.

kda_2v2.label: 2v2 takedown/death ratio
kda_2v2.description: Bot-lane 2v2 kills and assists divided by 2v2 deaths, with a minimum denominator of one.

kills_solo.label: Solo kills
kills_solo.description: Kills classified as isolated one-versus-one situations.

n_deaths.label: Total deaths
n_deaths.description: Total number of deaths in a match.

plates_diff_early.label: Lane turret-plate difference
plates_diff_early.description: Turret plates taken by your team minus plates conceded on your lane before 14 minutes.

pos_avg_dist_to_ally.label: Distance to the nearest ally
pos_avg_dist_to_ally.description: Average map distance to your closest teammate across timeline snapshots.

pos_avg_map_depth.label: Average depth in enemy territory
pos_avg_map_depth.description: Average distance travelled beyond the neutral map line into enemy territory. This is context, not a recommendation to push farther.

pos_control_wards_placed.label: Control wards placed
pos_control_wards_placed.description: Number of control wards placed during a match.

pos_frac_base.label: Time spent in base
pos_frac_base.description: Share of observed timeline snapshots spent inside your base.

pos_frac_enemy_half.label: Time spent in enemy territory
pos_frac_enemy_half.description: Share of observed timeline snapshots spent beyond the neutral map line in enemy territory.

pos_frac_overextended.label: Time spent far into enemy territory
pos_frac_overextended.description: Share of observed timeline snapshots spent more than 2,000 map units inside enemy territory.

pos_frac_own_lane_early.label: Early time in assigned lane
pos_frac_own_lane_early.description: Share of early-game timeline snapshots spent in the map zone assigned to your role.

pos_frac_river_early.label: Early time in river or jungle
pos_frac_river_early.description: Share of early-game timeline snapshots spent in the river or jungle zone.

pos_frac_roam_mid.label: Mid-game time roaming to other lanes
pos_frac_roam_mid.description: Share of mid-game timeline snapshots spent in a lane other than the one assigned to your role.

pos_gold_dead_time.label: Estimated time spent dead
pos_gold_dead_time.description: Estimated total respawn time generated by your deaths, based on champion level.

pos_max_map_depth.label: Maximum depth in enemy territory
pos_max_map_depth.description: Farthest observed distance beyond the neutral map line into enemy territory. This is context, not a recommendation to push farther.

pos_wards_killed.label: Enemy wards cleared
pos_wards_killed.description: Number of enemy wards destroyed during a match.

pos_wards_placed.label: Wards placed
pos_wards_placed.description: Number of wards placed during a match.

pos_wards_placed_early.label: Wards placed before 14 minutes
pos_wards_placed_early.description: Number of wards placed during the first 14 minutes.

support_deaths_early.label: Support deaths before 14 minutes
support_deaths_early.description: Deaths by your allied support before 14 minutes while you played bot carry.

win_rate.label: Win rate in the analysed window
win_rate.description: Share of wins among the role-specific matches used for this analysis. It is context, not an actionable recommendation.

xpd10.label: Experience difference at 10 minutes
xpd10.description: Your experience lead or deficit versus the opposing laner at 10 minutes.

xppm10.label: Experience per minute at 10 minutes
xppm10.description: Your average experience gained per minute during the first 10 minutes.
